data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Munaam" can be interpreted as an individual who is valued and cherished by Allah (God) and adds value to society through their actions, intentions, and essence. It signifies the importance of striving to be positive contributors to our communities and to the greater world, as this is a desired state in both worldly and spiritual terms. historical_references.context: Munaam's engineering and architectural skills were highly valued during the Umayyad Caliphate, and he was commissioned to design the Great Mosque of Damascus. The mosque was completed in 715 AD and was the largest mosque in the Islamic world at the time.
